newsitem.title: JAPAN: No decision yet on NTT share sales in 97/98 - MOF.
newsitem.headline: No decision yet on NTT share sales in 97/98 - MOF.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) has not decided yet whether it will sell any state-owned shares of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) next year, a MOF official told Reuters on Wednesday.

Asked about a morning newspaper report that said the government was likely to sell some NTT shares, perhaps as early as the April-June quarter, the official said: "The article is pure speculation. We have not yet decided on any policy on further sales of state-owned NTT shares."
The MOF planned to sell 500,000 NTT shares this business year to March 1997, but has sold none of them so far.
The official said the ministry was closely watching stock market conditions before making any decision on the sales.

Asked about the possibility of NTT share sales next business year, the official said negotiations were still underway between government ministries on how to draft next year's state budget, which would set the limit on how many NTT shares the government could sell in the year.
"We cannot set any policy on next year's NTT share sales before the 1997/98 budget is completed," he said.
NTT went public in early 1987, but the government still owns 65 percent of its shares.
